message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('fuzz/client.c')
s=p.read_text()
# try forcing a full handshake into TLS1.2 with DHE_RSA-only legacy ciphers
s=s.replace('    OPENSSL_assert(SSL_set_cipher_list(client, "ALL:eNULL:@SECLEVEL=0") == 1);\n','    OPENSSL_assert(SSL_set_cipher_list(client, "DHE-RSA-AES128-SHA:DHE-RSA-AES256-SHA:ADH-AES128-SHA:ADH-AES256-SHA") == 1);\n')
# remove OCSP/SRTP noise and keep no verify
for line in ['    SSL_set_tlsext_status_type(client, TLSEXT_STATUSTYPE_ocsp);\n','    SSL_set_tlsext_use_srtp(client, "SRTP_AES128_CM_SHA1_80");\n']:
    s=s.replace(line,'')
p.write_text(s)
print('patched3')
PY
sed -n '72,90p' fuzz/client.c
